if (selfTest === null) return;
    const text = selfTest.report();
killedBy: the self-test body loads when its pane first opens (issue #1013) Copy pressed before the body loaded throws nothing and writes nothing
why: Issue #1013. Copy pressed before the self-test's body has loaded no longer returns early: it throws nothing, but reveals, focuses and selects an empty report field for a readout that does not exist yet. The sibling entry `selftest-copy-before-load-throws` throws before anything is revealed, so only this one reaches the assertion that the field stays hidden.
